statements.statement: CARLA is an open-source urban driving simulator providing extensive digital assets including urban layouts, vehicles, buildings, pedestrians, and street signs, created by a dedicated team of digital artists.
It supports flexible sensor suite specification, environmental condition control, and provides exact measurements of agent state and traffic rule compliance.

CARLA enables development, training, prototyping, and validation of autonomous driving models including perception and control, and is used to evaluate classic modular pipelines, end-to-end imitation learning, and reinforcement learning approaches.
